label: Resolve GitHub issues
description: Coordinates reviewed issue fixes and verifies landing before closure.
firstMessage: Find the absolute current checkout root from the session cwd (for git, git rev-parse --show-toplevel), then read <root>/.sova/playbooks/resolve-github-issues/PLAYBOOK.md and follow it, resolving its references against that absolute bundle directory. This is a bootstrap reading instruction, not the playbook's JSON arguments. Invocation JSON: {}. Start with read-only intake. GitHub issues are the sole task-progress authority: reread their progress before dispatch/resume; generic continue never reopens deferred work or clears ownership/blocked gates. Local checkpoints hold evidence/recovery only. Confirm bounded progress-comment authority before implementation, and publication, landing, and closure authority before their mutations.
